Label.Name: vt.empty
Label.Text: No voxel type selected. Pick a type in the Paint window ("+" adds one), or press C over a voxel of the viewport.

Label.Name: vt.sides.hint
Label.Text: TOP only : a platform you can jump through from below.

PropertyRow.Label: Texture
PropertyRow.Tip: Image of assets/ (drag it from the Content Browser). Multiplied by the color : white shows the raw texture.

PropertyRow.Name: vt.tile.row
PropertyRow.Label: Tile (voxels)
PropertyRow.Tip: Voxels covered by one copy of the texture (1 : the whole image on each voxel).

PropertyRow.Label: Preset
PropertyRow.Tip: Fills every value below (and the collision : liquids and gases do not block).

PropertyRow.Name: vt.density.row
PropertyRow.Label: Density
PropertyRow.Tip: Heavier sinks in lighter liquids / gases (sand 1.6, water 1, oil 0.8).

PropertyRow.Name: vt.dispersion.row
PropertyRow.Label: Dispersion
PropertyRow.Tip: Cells it can move sideways per step : how fast it spreads.

PropertyRow.Name: vt.drag.row
PropertyRow.Label: Drag
PropertyRow.Tip: Slows down the actors inside (0 nothing, 1 very thick).

PropertyRow.Name: vt.buoyancy.row
PropertyRow.Label: Buoyancy
PropertyRow.Tip: Pushes the actors inside up (1 cancels gravity, more floats).

PropertyRow.Name: vt.friction.row
PropertyRow.Label: Friction
PropertyRow.Tip: Grip of the characters on it : 1 normal, 0.1 ice, 2.5 mud.

PropertyRow.Label: Damage / s
PropertyRow.Tip: Damageable.TakeDamage(amount, null) to the actors touching it (lava, spikes).

Checkbox.Name: vt.contact
Checkbox.Tooltip: VoxelEvents.OnVoxelContact(name, type) / OnVoxelContactEnd to the actors that implement it.

Label.Text: Simulated while the game runs, around the cameras. The voxel world comes back after Play.

Button.Name: vt.delete
Button.Tooltip: Only the last type can be deleted : the levels store the number of the types.
